name: net.fosa.avatar-texture-optimizer
description: An open-source NDMF texture optimizer for VRChat avatars. Builds UV-to-texture mappings, per-island quality-driven scaling, island-shape raster atlas packing, and safe reference rewriting. / 开源的 VRChat Avatar NDMF 贴图优化工具：UV-贴图映射、逐岛质量缩放、岛形光栅图集装箱与安全引用重写。
